mechanics_comparisons.title: Jacks or Better / 视频扑克
known_gameplay: 独立五张牌视频扑克：下注发5张，选择保留，再换掉未保留牌，按最终牌型和原赔付表结算。没有德州扑克公共牌或与庄家比较21点；本轮真实保留黑桃10，换牌得到A和8两对并结算。
mechanics_comparisons.distinction: This game places4of5face-up cards perround on a4x4 grid and discards1, independently scores rows/columns/fourcorners/discards with a hand-count multiplier. No wager/draw-and-hold/AI poker opponent or solitaire foundations.
